protocol.timer: perf_counter_ns, CUDA synchronize immediately before and after policy.act
protocol.included_work: policy state/entity and batch preparation, transfers, full-team actor, temporal update, legal action selection, action decoding
protocol.excluded_work: model loading, policy reset, warmup, environment physics/opponent update, centralized value diagnostics, recording and file I/O
protocol.main_average: sum elapsed over calls with >=1 live defender / count of those calls
protocol.secondary_average: all actual policy.act calls, including zero-live tails, retained separately
protocol.sd: sample SD of the 20 episode active-step means; descriptive scene variation, not training-seed uncertainty
protocol.warmup: 10 reset-and-forward calls on the first measured scene initial state for each arm/config; no extra episodes
protocol.order: serial; rotate seven arms by scene index and configuration index
protocol.checkpoint_configuration: loaded unchanged; only fixed execution depth set

protocol.module_loading: bypass eager HAD package initializers via package search paths; import unchanged model/controller modules
protocol.startup_note: Initial import failed before any model decision because open_score package initializer required had_env; no measured calls in that attempt
protocol.padding: compact: N defenders + N attackers + 2 targets; all present/alive
protocol.input: one identical deterministic synthetic entity table per count, shared by all seven arms
protocol.history: fixed previous actions arange(N) % 9; restore zero GRU state before each call outside timer
protocol.timer: perf_counter_ns, CUDA synchronize immediately before and after mac.select_actions plus CPU action-list materialization
protocol.included_work: controller input concatenation/masking, full-team actor, temporal update, existing greedy action selector, action output to CPU list
protocol.excluded_work: model loading, synthetic feature preparation, initial GPU upload, hidden-state restoration, warmup, environment, centralized mixer, recording/file I/O
protocol.statistics: arithmetic mean of 100 full-team calls; sample SD across calls retained in raw summary
protocol.order: serial; rotate the 14 cells by repetition index
protocol.checkpoint_configuration: saved architecture and weights unchanged; resize count metadata and set execution depth only

protocol.statistic: mean scenes within configuration/model, then equal configuration mean, then mean and sample SD across three models
protocol.contrast: D(R1/R2/R3)-D(R4), paired on training model and all 100 scene seeds; positive means shallower execution is worse
protocol.damage_ratio: ratio of group mean D(shallow) to group mean D(R4), not mean of scene ratios
protocol.physical_protocol_status: legacy records did not register HAD core version or physics protocol; unchanged legacy provenance retained

source.R4_reuse: existing final_eval/final; R4 identified by saved global_eval_depth=4
source.R1_R3_reuse: existing depth_eval/depth:R1-R3; execution depth checked against cycle_depth

LEAF_reference.pairing_status: configuration-matched 300-scene reference; no cross-method scene-paired inference; LEAF R1-R3 raw logs unavailable locally

interpretation.mean_shallow_degradation: large average damage increases at R1/R2 in the three observed configurations
interpretation.seed_heterogeneity: seed 0 and seed 2 degrade at R1/R2; seed 1 is not consistently worse than R4
interpretation.causal_limit: Fixed depth uses stopped-gradient historical hidden in the query; LEAF zeros query memory, so depth training is not the only changed factor
interpretation.scope_limit: three pre-existing K2 configurations, not the complete 24-configuration evaluation or universal shallow-depth behavior
interpretation.physical_protocol_limit: legacy Fixed depth episode rows lack registered core/physics protocol; physical equivalence to LEAF Table 6 cannot be retroactively established
interpretation.uncertainty_limit: only three training-model replicates; report t95 including intervals crossing zero without converting many scenes into independent model replicates

figure_encoding.lines: Fixed depth mean plus three individual training-model means; LEAF 300-scene mean
figure_encoding.error_bars: not drawn; sample SD and t95 reported in the report and summary

protocol.feature: receiver A read before stage fusion, W_f and temporal GRU
protocol.label: specified B within 300 m of the unique approached target of X
protocol.initial_hidden: zero independently for every state and arm
protocol.task_mode: static damage-feature input; no physics engine

feature_extraction.LEAF-H0: same trained LEAF query_proj/read_attn applied to captured H[0]
feature_extraction.LEAF-H1: captured u[0] in normal two-round forward; agrees with genuine R1
feature_extraction.LEAF-H2: captured u[1] in normal two-round forward
feature_extraction.temporal_hidden: zero on every state/arm, including trained Direct read
feature_extraction.query_difference: LEAF query excludes hidden; Direct read normally has detached hidden, which is zero here

interpretation.outcome: no convincing closure: all four linear probes are near chance in the held-out controlled distribution
interpretation.H2_vs_H1: small mean gain; negative for seed 2 at all three configurations; paired seed t95 crosses zero
interpretation.B_position_control: exactly 50% on each configuration under crossed X-target/B-target labels
interpretation.far_control: held-out false-positive rates remain substantial; not a reliable generalized covered/uncovered decoder
limits: linear decoder failure does not prove information absent
H0 read of LEAF was not trained as a deployment exit; trained Direct read is an additional retrained control
controlled static geometry, zero temporal history and specified-B coverage differ from real battle trajectories
the 300 m label is a nominal geometric relation, not an actual interception-success or reactive probability label
R1 can use fully visible entity-attention shortcuts; relation order is not a mandatory depth lower bound
Q changes are input sensitivity rather than proof of correct threat interpretation

statistics.replicates: three trained policy seeds, shared generated scenes and shared split
statistics.aggregation: template-state accuracy within each seed/config/arm, equal configuration mean within seed, then mean/sample SD across seeds
